data.title: Story Bridge
data.description: Compare characters, settings, events, and big ideas across two illustrated stories.

stories.title: Sharing At The Park
stories.opening: The bright afternoon sun shone down on the green grass at the park.
stories.closing: Both friends smiled and played happily together until it was time to go home.
stories.mainIdea: Sharing toys at the park makes playing fun for friends.

characters.name: Leo
characters.sentence: Leo shared a red toy car with his friend.

characters.name: Mia
characters.sentence: Mia helped kick a bouncing ball back to her friend.

characters.name: Ben
characters.sentence: Ben shared a sweet red apple with his friend.

stories.title: Sharing At The Beach
stories.opening: The warm morning breeze blew across the soft sand at the beach.
stories.closing: Both friends smiled and built a tall castle together until the sun went down.
stories.mainIdea: Sharing sand tools at the beach makes building fun for friends.

characters.name: Sam
characters.sentence: Sam shared a yellow bucket with his friend.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.sentence: Zoe helped find a shiny seashell with her friend.

characters.name: Max
characters.sentence: Max shared a yummy chocolate cookie with his friend.

challenges.comparisonSummary: Leo shared a red car, but Sam shared a yellow bucket.
Zoe found a seashell, but Mia played with a ball.
Ben ate a fresh apple, but Max ate a chocolate cookie.
